C0462.title: Nanchang Xihu Court Fake Transfer Screenshot Fraud Case
C0462.summary: In March 2023, the Nanchang Xihu District People's Court disclosed a fraud case involving Zhou's forged transfer screenshots. On September 20, 2022, Zhou claimed he was buying a used car from dealer Wei, created a fake RMB 40,000 WeChat transfer screenshot, and used an alleged payment error and delayed arrival as a pretext to obtain use of the vehicle. On October 28, he attempted the same method to obtain eighteen bottles of Jiannanchun liquor from a department-store supermarket, but failed. On November 4, he claimed he was buying liquor and cigarettes, then created a fake RMB 22,000 Bank of Communications transfer screenshot to obtain eighteen bottles of liquor and six cartons of cigarettes from a tobacco and liquor shop. The court found him guilty of fraud and, considering the attempted offense, confession, guilty plea, partial compensation, and recidivism, sentenced him to four years and three months in prison plus a RMB 51,000 fine.
